content.fundamental_question: Does entity control specified good/service BEFORE transfer to customer?

principal.example: Retailer buys inventory, resells. Controls goods.

agent.definition: Arranges for another party to provide good/service. Does NOT control.
agent.example: Travel agent books flight. Airline provides service.

indicators_of_principal: Entity primarily responsible for fulfilling promise
Entity has inventory risk (before or after transfer)
Entity has discretion in setting prices
indicators_of_agent: Another party primarily responsible for fulfillment
Entity's promise is to arrange for other party to provide goods/services
Entity does not have inventory risk
Entity earns commission (fixed fee or percentage)

control_assessment.key_question: Who controls specified good/service before transfer to customer?
control_assessment.obtain_then_transfer: If entity obtains control THEN transfers → Principal
control_assessment.arrange_without_control: If entity arranges but never controls → Agent

principal.cost: Cost of goods/services as separate expense (COGS)

example_principal.scenario: Company purchases electronics from manufacturer for $800, resells to customers for $1,000. Controls inventory, sets prices, responsible for returns.
example_principal.accounting: DR Inventory $800, CR AP $800. DR AR $1,000, CR Revenue $1,000. DR COGS $800, CR Inventory $800. Gross profit $200.

example_agent.scenario: Online marketplace connects buyers and sellers. Sellers list items, buyers purchase. Marketplace earns 10% commission. Marketplace never owns goods.
example_agent.accounting: If sale price $1,000, marketplace earns $100. DR AR $100 (or DR Cash $1,000, CR Payable to seller $900), CR Revenue $100.

content.consignment_as_agent: Consignee is agent. Consignor is principal. Consignee recognizes net commission, not gross sales.

shipping_and_fulfillment.if_entity_controls: If entity responsible for shipping, arranges carrier → Indicator of principal
shipping_and_fulfillment.if_customer_arranges: If customer arranges shipping → Less indicative of principal

pricing_discretion.establishes_price: Entity sets selling price → Indicator of principal
pricing_discretion.fixed_commission: Entity earns fixed fee regardless of price → Indicator of agent

inventory_risk.before_transfer: Entity purchases inventory before customer orders → Principal
inventory_risk.after_transfer: Entity accepts returns, responsible for defects → Principal
inventory_risk.no_inventory_risk: Entity never owns, customer orders then entity sources → Agent

common_scenarios.drop_shipping: Analyze control. If company takes title to goods (even briefly), controls → Principal. If just arranges shipment → Agent.
common_scenarios.gift_cards: Issuer is principal for goods provided. Third-party retailers selling gift cards are agents.
common_scenarios.travel_bookings: Travel agent arranging airline/hotel typically agent. If pre-purchases blocks of rooms/seats → Principal.

cpa_exam_tips: Key question: Does entity CONTROL good/service before transfer to customer?
Principal: Gross revenue. Agent: Net commission.
Indicators of principal: Inventory risk, pricing discretion, primary responsibility
Indicators of agent: Arranges for others, no inventory risk, earns commission
Consignee = Agent (net commission). Consignor = Principal (gross revenue).
Control is determinative (not just whether owns inventory)

decision_framework: 2. Ask: Does entity control it before transfer to customer?
4. If controls → Principal (gross). If arranges → Agent (net).
common_mistakes: Focusing on legal title instead of control
Assuming drop-shipper is always agent (depends on control)
Recording gross revenue for agent (should be net)
Not considering all control indicators (not just inventory)

key_points: Principal: Controls good/service before transfer → Gross revenue
Agent: Arranges without control → Net commission revenue
Control indicators: Inventory risk, pricing discretion, primary responsibility
Consignee = Agent. Drop-shipper = Depends on control assessment.
Key question: Does entity control specified good/service before transfer?
